home.intro: From small meaningful pieces to large & bold custom designs, Inked By Iona is all about creating tattoos that feel like you.

about.heading: Hey, I'm Iona!
about.name: The founder of Inked By Iona
about.paragraph1:
I'm the founder of Inked By Iona, a self-taught tattoo artist based in Berwick-upon-Tweed.
I love bringing people's ideas to life, whether that's something small and meaningful, a bold statement piece or a design that's completely unique to you.
about.paragraph2:
While I've mainly focused on black and grey tattooing so far, I'm always happy exploring new styles, techniques and creative ideas as I develop my own artistic specialty.
I love a bit of variety, so I'm always excited to hear what you've got in mind and work together to create something you'll love!

services.title: Custom Tattoos
services.description: Personalised designs developed together around your ideas, inspiration pictures, placement and individual style.

services.title: Flash Designs
services.description: Choose from my available flash designs, offered at set prices and sizes. Keep an eye on my socials for new releases, or browse available designs on Venue Ink!
